title: From maker to manager: find your hours and write your standard
course_title: Fashion Business Management: Production Operations for Scaling

say: From maker to manager: find your hours and write your standard.
This is the video for module 1 of Fashion Business Management.
This module is for a workroom with paying clients that wants to produce more, without the owner sewing every seam.
It starts with one honest question. Where do my hours actually go?

say: For 10 working days, write the time and the task every time you switch task. Do not judge it, just record.
Two weeks is the minimum, because one week can be unusual.

panel.heading: The two-week time log
items: Log every task switch for 10 working days
Cutting, sewing, finishing, client time
Buying, admin and messages, rework
Mark each heading owner-only or transferable

say: Each day, add up the hours under the same headings. Cutting, sewing, finishing, and client time for measuring and fittings.

say: Then buying, admin and WhatsApp messages, and rework. If you have helpers, ask them to log too. Their logs show where they wait for you.

say: Now ask of each heading: could a trained person do this to my standard, with a written method and a check?
Be strict. They will not do it as well as me is a training problem, not a reason to keep the task forever.

say: Adaeze logged 120 working hours over 10 days. Only 40% of that time truly needed her. The other 60% could be done by someone else.

say: Then she grouped 3 months of orders by type and divided income by owner hours. Aso-ebi pieces earned about 6,250 naira per owner hour, because she cuts several at once.

say: Alterations paid least, about 3,333 naira per hour. They bring new clients, so she keeps them, but they are the first task to hand to a helper.

say: A workroom moves at the speed of its slowest step, called the constraint or bottleneck.
Adaeze's helpers sat idle most mornings, waiting for her to cut. Another machine would just stand idle too.

panel.heading: Widen the slow step first
right: Write: my workroom is limited by...

say: So her first move was to free her cutting time.
Write one sentence for your workroom: right now my workroom is limited by, and fill in the gap.

panel.heading: Widen the slow step first
right: Write: my workroom is limited by...

say: To compare models, work out contribution per workroom hour: price minus materials, divided by the hours each piece takes.
Made-to-measure gave Adaeze about 6,000 naira per hour, her best and safest return.

panel.heading: Three ways to add to bespoke

cards.d: Your tested pattern, adjusted to her measurements. About 6,000 naira per hour for Adaeze. The bridge to scale.
A run of one style in set sizes. Fast to cut and sew, but cash is tied up in stock that may not sell.
Cut, make, trim for another brand. Lower fee, no selling. Good for filling quiet weeks.

say: A batch of 20 tops earned about 3,313 naira per hour when only 14 sold. So start with small runs and take pre-orders.

say: Break each style into small numbered operations, like insert invisible zip. Time a trained worker on your phone stopwatch, at least 5 times.

panel.heading: Timing one operation
items: Time the same operation 5 times
Average the times: observed time
Multiply by the pace rating
Add the allowance, for example 15%
Sign off after 3 matching pieces in a row

say: Adaeze timed Chioma on zips. The 5 times added to 50.0 minutes, so the observed time is 10.0 minutes.

panel.heading: Timing one operation
items: Time the same operation 5 times

Multiply by the pace rating
Add the allowance, for example 15%
Sign off after 3 matching pieces in a row

say: Chioma is careful but a little slow, so Adaeze rated her at 90%. 10.0 times 0.90 gives 9.0 minutes.

panel.heading: Timing one operation

say: Add a 15% allowance for fatigue and small delays. 9.0 times 1.15 is 10.35, so about 10 standard minutes.

say: Train one operation at a time, and sign it off when the helper makes 3 pieces in a row that match the golden sample.

say: Show the safe way first. Fingers clear of the needle, machine off before changing needles, scissors closed and put down, irons on their heel and switched off at the wall.

panel.rule: A fast operation done unsafely is not signed off.

say: A golden sample is one garment of each style you have approved. Label it, keep it clean in a bag, and keep a specification card beside it.
When a helper asks, is this right, the answer is, compare it with the golden sample, not ask madam.

panel.heading: Label it and keep it clean
items: Style code, size, date, your signature
Kept in a bag, not on the rail for sale
Spec card: measurements, stitch, thread, trims
The operation list with standard minutes

say: To remember. Log your hours before buying machines. Income per owner hour shows which orders feed you. Widen your constraint first.
Build standard minutes from observed time, rating and allowance. And let a golden sample hold the standard.

items: Log your hours for two weeks before buying machines
